build_contingency_matrix: build a contingency matrix describing the relationship between true and predicted cluster labels
compute_adjusted_rand_score: compute the adjusted rand score to measure similarity between two clusterings adjusted for chance
evaluate_homogeneity_completeness_v_meas: evaluate homogeneity, completeness, and V-measure scores for cluster labeling against ground truth
calculate_mutual_information_score: calculate mutual information score measuring similarity between two label clusterings
compute_fowlkes_mallows_score: compute the Fowlkes-Mallows score measuring similarity of two clusterings using geometric mean of precision and recall
